home_about_partner_body: The project is carried out with the guidance and support of the {#b}Ủy ban Nhà nước về người Việt Nam ở nước ngoài – Bộ Ngoại giao{/b}.
home_about_digital_body: We digitize publications, including books from {#b}NXB Đại học Sư phạm TP. Hồ Chí Minh{/b}, as part of the program Honoring Vietnamese in Overseas Vietnamese Communities launched by {#b}UBNVONN – Bộ Ngoại giao{/b}, and the curriculum of the {#b}Khai Minh Đức{/b} school system (whose motto is "Tiên học lễ, hậu học văn", manners first, then learning).
home_about_network_body: The project is part of the {#b}Viet Youth Readiness Hub{/b} initiative of the Canada Vietnam Cultural & Educational Council (CVCEC).
home_about_network_body_2: We are also an active member of the global network for teaching Vietnamese language and culture ({#b}VIETLANGNET{/b}). From June to September 2025 we are helping build its global map of Vietnamese classes, an interactive map of Vietnamese classes for Vietnamese communities around the world.
home_about_copyright_body: Ownership and copyright of the platform are protected and belong to its co-authors: Phan Thị Quỳnh Trang, Nguyễn Trần Thanh Hải, Đỗ Thị Phương Mai, Trần Thanh Phúc, Trần Văn Nhật.
home_thanks_body: The project team sincerely thanks the {#b}Ủy ban Nhà nước về người Việt Nam ở nước ngoài – Bộ Ngoại giao{/b} of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam for its constant support and guidance. We are deeply grateful to the embassies, the government agencies in Vietnam and Canada, and the Vietnamese teaching network, whose generous help made it possible for {#b}"Trường Tiếng Việt Của Em"{/b} to be completed and launched. Your support gives us great strength to preserve and share the Vietnamese language and culture with young people in Canada and around the world.
home_support_heading: Help keep Vietnamese alive for every child.
home_support_body: {#b}"Trường Tiếng Việt Của Em"{/b} is a non-profit project. We warmly welcome support, contributions and sponsorship from parents, overseas Vietnamese and generous donors. Every contribution, however small, is precious.
home_support_free_body: 40+ lessons across 8 themes, open to every child, for life, at no cost.
home_support_digitize_body: Continuing the Vui học Tiếng Việt books from NXB ĐH Sư Phạm TP Hồ Chí Minh.
home_support_speaking_body: Pictures, sounds, games and recordings that help children speak Vietnamese with confidence.

home_info_about_subtitle: A short look at the mission, partners and copyright of Trường Tiếng Việt Của Em.
home_info_digital_body: The project digitizes two books from {#b}NXB ĐH Sư Phạm TP Hồ Chí Minh{/b}, as part of the program Honoring Vietnamese in Overseas Vietnamese Communities launched by {#b}UBNVONN – Bộ Ngoại giao{/b}.
home_info_network_body: The project is an active member of the {#b}Mạng lưới các cơ sở giảng dạy tiếng Việt và văn hóa Việt Nam ở nước ngoài{/b}, the network of Vietnamese language and culture schools abroad.
home_info_copyright_body: The project's copyright is held by its co-authors: Phan Thị Quỳnh Trang, Nguyễn Trần Thanh Hải, Đỗ Thị Phương Mai, Trần Thanh Phúc, Trần Văn Nhật.
home_info_support_heading: Help plant the seeds of heritage for the next generation
home_info_support_body: Keeping our mother tongue alive far from home is a proud mission, but it takes a lot of resources. The non-profit project {#b}"Trường Tiếng Việt Của Em"{/b} warmly welcomes support, contributions and sponsorship from parents, overseas Vietnamese and generous donors, to keep Vietnamese culture alive in young hearts. home_teachers_og_description: Meet the teachers who work with Trường Tiếng Việt Của Em.
home_teacher_role_president: President of the Canada Vietnam Cultural & Educational Council (CVCEC)
home_teacher_bio_trang: Deputy Secretary General of the global network for teaching Vietnamese language and culture.
home_teacher_bio_ha: As Academic and Vietnamese Language Director at CVCEC (PEI), Ms. Hoàng Minh Hà leads the development of the language curriculum and cultural heritage initiatives, strengthening overseas Vietnamese identity and engaging the younger generation.
home_teacher_bio_mai: As Academic Advisor at CVCEC (Finland), Ms. Đỗ Thị Phương Mai specializes in Vietnamese teaching methods, designing heritage-based curricula that make learning effective, engaging and rich in culture.
home_teacher_bio_binh: Ms. Nguyễn Thị Thanh Bình is a dedicated Vietnamese teacher at CVCEC in PEI, with a deep passion for preserving cultural heritage and bringing the community together.
home_teacher_bio_dieu_anh: As a Vietnamese teacher at CVCEC in Manitoba, Ms. Ngô Nguyễn Ngọc Diệu Anh inspires and empowers her students through language and cultural activities.
